status.en: 19 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Bangkok, Chiang Rai and Pattaya.
status.nb: 19 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Bangkok, Chiang Rai og Pattaya.

summary.en: Violent attacks continued in the insurgency zone, with pipe bombs wounding army officers and security volunteers in Narathiwat and Yala and grenade attacks in Trang leading to arrests and seizure of explosives. A Chinese suspect was detained in Bangkok after attempting a 100,000 baht border crossing, and Malaysia appointed a new facilitator for southern Thailand peace talks. Cambodia and Thailand agreed on confidence-building measures at a UNCLOS meeting and discussed easing maritime border tensions, while the WTO and multilateral partners reviewed progress on a supply-chain finance initiative. Floods in Thailand killed 80 people as waters receded. The conflict recorded 35 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Southern Thailand insurgency
background.extract: The Southern Thailand insurgency is an ongoing conflict centered in southern Thailand. It originated in 1948 as a separatist insurgency in the historical Malay Patani Region, made up of the three southernmost provinces of Thailand and parts of a fourth, but has become more complex and increasingly violent since the early 2000s from drug cartels, oil smuggling networks, and sometimes pirate raids.
background.extractNb: Opprøret i Sør-Thailand er en pågående konflikt mellom thailandske styrker og islamistiske separatistgrupper, i de tre sørligste provinsene i Thailand. Volden sprer seg også i økt grad over til andre provinser. Selv om separatistene riktignok har opptrådt voldelig i flere tiår, eskalerte kampanjen deres i 2004.
